title: UDP
synonyms: datagram listen bind port send broadcast reply last sender
about: Listen on a UDP port, send datagrams to any host, broadcast, and reply to the last sender.

title: UDP broadcast
synonyms: 255.255.255.255 send to everyone subnet
about: Tick Broadcast to send to the whole subnet.

title: TCP
synonyms: client server connect listen accept socket stream reconnect
about: TCP client and server in one tab, both live at once, with auto-reconnect and per-client send.

title: TCP server (listen)
synonyms: listen accept clients broadcast to all clients netcat -l
about: Listen on a port, accept many clients, send to one or all.

title: TCP client (connect)
synonyms: connect out host port reconnect
about: Connect to a host and port; reconnects automatically when asked.

title: Multicast
synonyms: join group 239 ttl loopback igmp interface adapter
about: Join a multicast group on a chosen interface with TTL and loopback control.

title: Multicast interface (Auto)
synonyms: which adapter physical virtual setsockopt refresh
about: Auto prefers physical adapters; open the list to rescan adapters.

title: NATS
synonyms: subject wildcard request reply 4222 publish subscribe
about: Subjects with * and > wildcards, request/reply.

title: Kafka
synonyms: topic partition offset consumer group 9092 redpanda produce consume
about: Topics, consumer group, partition selector, offsets.

title: MQTT
synonyms: topic qos retained 1883 mosquitto + # wildcard
about: + and # wildcards, QoS 0/1/2, retained messages, client id.

title: Publish a message to a broker
synonyms: send message topic subject payload
about: The publish box at the bottom of every broker tab.

title: Serial port
synonyms: com port uart baud parity stop bits flow control dtr rts terminal
about: Port list, line settings, DTR/RTS, send and receive.

title: Modbus
synonyms: rtu tcp plc register coil holding input function code poll 502
about: Modbus RTU over serial or Modbus TCP: decoded frames, request builder, polling.

title: Modbus CRC table and parameters
synonyms: checksum paste table vendor manual polynomial custom crc16 byte order
about: Pick a CRC preset, type parameters, or paste a 256-entry lookup table from a vendor manual.

title: Modbus polling
synonyms: repeat request interval read registers periodically
about: Send the built request on an interval.

title: USB capture
synonyms: usbpcap sniff transfers bulk interrupt control descriptors root hub device list
about: Live USB capture: pick a root hub, tick devices, see every transfer below the driver.

title: USB stream view
synonyms: serial bytes over usb ftdi cp210x com port traffic watch what a program sends out in terminal modbus rtu
about: One device's bulk transfers as OUT and IN byte streams, FTDI status bytes stripped, Modbus RTU decoded.

title: USB records table
synonyms: one row per transfer urb setup packet descriptor
about: Every transfer with its URB, setup packet or descriptor decoded.

title: USB devices to capture
synonyms: tick device root hub keyboard warning all devices
about: Tick the devices to watch; a warning appears when a keyboard is included.

title: HID input devices
synonyms: controller gamepad joystick buttons axes sticks triggers hat joy.cpl game controller test
about: Live view of any HID device: buttons light up, sticks move dots, triggers fill bars.

title: Controller rumble (vibration)
synonyms: xbox vibrate motors pulse xinput force feedback
about: Left and right motor sliders and a pulse button for Xbox controllers.

title: Send a HID output report
synonyms: led vendor command write bytes to device
about: Raw output report, hex with the report id first.

title: Which buttons never registered
synonyms: dead button broken not working check diagnose
about: On close, the tab lists buttons that never registered a press.

title: HTTP request tester
synonyms: rest api get post put delete headers body json auth bearer basic curl postman
about: Requests with headers, body and auth; response viewer with timing; history.

title: HTTP authentication
synonyms: bearer token basic password header
about: Basic and Bearer auth; tokens belong in presets as ${VAR} placeholders.

title: WebSocket
synonyms: ws wss frames text binary ping pong
about: Connect, send text or binary frames, ping with round-trip timing.

title: SSH
synonyms: shell login remote terminal exec command key password host key
about: Password or key auth, interactive shell, one-shot commands with exit codes.

title: SSH tunnels (port forwarding)
synonyms: forward -L -R local remote port reach device behind server expose local service
about: Local and remote port forwards over the SSH session, restarted after a reconnect.

title: SFTP file browser
synonyms: files upload download rename delete folder remote
about: Browse the remote file system, transfer files, rename, delete, new folder.

title: Telnet
synonyms: option negotiation old gear console 23
about: Telnet console with RFC 854 option negotiation.

title: Packet capture
synonyms: wireshark sniffer pcap npcap ethernet tcp udp arp dns interface packets frames traffic
about: Wireshark-style packet table off the adapter, even when another program owns the port.

title: Capture filter (BPF)
synonyms: tcpdump syntax udp port host not port driver filter
about: Filter applied in the driver, tcpdump syntax: udp port 16004, host 192.168.1.10.

title: Display filter
synonyms: ip.addr port len contains and or not narrow table search packets
about: Narrows the table as you type: ip.addr == 192.168.1., port == 1883, contains "hello", usb.type == bulk.

title: Open or save a pcap file
synonyms: load file wireshark export import usbpcap
about: Open .pcap files, including USBPcap ones, and save the shown packets.

title: Filter a conversation or host
synonyms: context menu right click follow
about: Right-click a packet to filter its conversation or host, or send its payload to the Decoder.

title: Decoder (bytes to fields)
synonyms: decode bytes paste hex layout widths int float double string big little endian parse struct fields decrypt
about: Paste bytes, describe the layout as field widths, read every field as integers, floats and text.

title: Decoder layout grammar
synonyms: 2 3 5 6 4 hints 4f 2i 5s groups [2 4]*3 repeat
about: Widths like 2 3 5 6 4, type hints 4f 2i 5s 3x, repeated groups [2 4]*3, * for the rest.

title: Network sweep (who is on the LAN)
synonyms: ping sweep hosts up down /24 subnet ip addresses occupied available grid mac arp gateway
about: Pick an interface, sweep its /24; hosts appear on a grid and in a table with MAC and hostname.

title: Which network to sweep
synonyms: adapter wifi ethernet custom network base
about: Each adapter address with its prefix; the sweep covers the /24 around it.

title: Find silent hosts through ARP
synonyms: firewalled hosts no ping mac address neighbour table
about: After the sweep the ARP table adds MACs and finds hosts that ignored ping.

title: Local ports (what is listening)
synonyms: tcp ports listening in use reserved free process owner pid netstat which program
about: Survey local TCP ports: listening with owning process, in use, reserved, free; blocks grid and table.

title: Check if the ports I need are free
synonyms: available taken occupied conflict clash bind fails verdict my software wants
about: List the ports your software needs; each gets a verdict: free, or taken and by whom.

title: Port range to scan
synonyms: 1-1024 65535 well-known registered dynamic presets
about: Ranges and lists, with presets for well-known, registered and dynamic ports.

title: Reserved ports (Windows excluded ranges)
synonyms: hyper-v excludedportrange bind forbidden access denied
about: Ports the OS refuses to bind show as reserved; Windows excluded ranges are the usual cause.

title: Show the log
synonyms: console output tx rx bytes hex ascii timestamps hidden bottom panel
about: Every module writes to one log. Hidden by default; the toolbar button or Ctrl+` shows it.

title: Export the log (text or CSV)
synonyms: save log file csv download
about: Save the log as text or CSV from the log panel toolbar.

title: Filter the log by module or kind
synonyms: chips tx rx error only module text search delta time
about: Per-module and per-kind chips, a text filter, absolute or delta timestamps.

title: Save or load a preset
synonyms: remember setup configuration profile name save load delete ~/.linkscope/presets.json
about: Each tab saves its fields under a name; Load restores them.

title: Environment variables and secrets in presets
synonyms: env .env placeholder password token secret broker list per environment dev staging
about: Any preset field may contain ${VAR}, resolved from .env then the environment; keep secrets there, not in the preset.

title: Switch light / dark theme
synonyms: dark mode light mode appearance
about: The sun/moon button toggles the theme at runtime.

title: Collapse the sidebar
synonyms: hamburger menu hide groups more space Ctrl+B
about: The hamburger button or Ctrl+B collapses the sidebar; group headers fold their modules.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
synonyms: hotkeys ctrl k l h i b 1 2 3 enter up down history
about: Ctrl+K find, Ctrl+1..9 modules, Ctrl+B sidebar, Ctrl+` log, Ctrl+L clear, Ctrl+H hex, Ctrl+I decode, Enter sends.

title: Send to Decoder from anywhere
synonyms: Ctrl+I right click payload log line decode these bytes
about: Any log line, packet payload or USB record can be sent to the Decoder.

title: Version and module state
synonyms: which version am i running build date rights
about: Bottom left shows the selected module and its state, bottom right the version.
